commit.message:
Extend ReduceAllocationMerges to support klass load folding

This patch enables known-klass load folding when the `Load[N]Klass` node
has its address derived from a Phi node.  Effectively, the klass loading
node is now replaced with a new Phi node that selects each path's
already-known klass directly.  In particular, this patch broadens the
criteria when Phi node users that are `LoadKlass` or `LoadNKlass` nodes
become eligible for scalar replacement in `can_reduce_check_users()`.
This patch also adds code to replace the `LoadKlass` and `LoadNKlass`
nodes with a Phi node that operates directly on the klass values
themselves.  Although this patch doesn't remove the backing `Allocate`
node, if there are no other uses of the allocation, ordinary dead-code
elimination and macro expansion end up discarding the allocation.

In addition to new tests in TestKnownKlassAllocationMerges.java that
exercise folding of the `Load[N]Klass` nodes, this patch updates the
comments for the `testLoadUnknownKlass()` test case (previously
`testLoadKlassFromCast()`) in TestKnownKlassAllocationMerges.java, since
that test case exercises a scenario when the precise class cannot be
derived at compile time.  I've validated this patch using Tier 1 through
3 tests in the JDK, HotSpot, and LangTools test groups.
